description: Post-#127 structural ceiling for Insight Hub 2 after the browser-CI and dead-code hardening pass. The active application keeps one shell, three global CSS layers, the reviewed component-level style blocks, lazy-loaded workspaces, and the protected Hub 2 intelligence ownership routes. The unmounted Entity Discovery frontend and its manual/bulk location panels, along with the disconnected legacy workflow/filter/map/report/section/side-panel and legacy intelligence data-client chain, have been removed. CinematicPortal remains intentionally retained as a reviewed required production file. Duplicate files, generated artifacts, invalid coordinates, extra app shells, new unreachable frontend files, additional architecture candidates, and additional injected-style files remain prohibited unless this baseline is deliberately reviewed and updated.
